name: obsidian-completr
description: This plugin provides advanced auto-completion capabilities for Obsidian

scripts.check: bun check --no-script && bun lint --no-script --type-aware --max-warnings 0 src test scripts && bun fmt --no-script --check src test scripts
scripts.version: bun scripts/version-bump.ts && git add manifest.json versions.json
scripts.fix: bun lint --no-script --fix src test scripts && bun fmt --no-script src test scripts

author: tth05
